geometry_analysis.width_description: Non-uniform; the weld exhibits a bulbous, wide profile at the Start (left side) which tapers down to a narrower width through the Middle and End
geometry_analysis.surface_profile: Convex reinforcement height, particularly high at the start
geometry_analysis.linearity: Straight alignment along the longitudinal axis

visual_anomalies.visual_description: Cluster of distinct, round, deep black cavities (macroscopic porosity)
visual_anomalies.visual_severity: Severe; multiple voids visible with high contrast darkness

surface_state.spatter_distribution: Multiple metallic globules adhered to the base plate adjacent to the toes along the full length
surface_state.discoloration: Brown/orange glassy islands (silica) adhering to the center face of the weld bead
